mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an attic conversion and a loft conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, 'attic conversion' and 'loft conversion' both refer to transforming an unused attic space into a habitable room. In practice, the terms are generally synonymous, describing the process of reinforcing floors, adding insulation, and installing windows or dormers to create a new living area. The distinction can sometimes depend on regional terminology or the extent of structural alteration. Our focus is on making the most of your available overhead space, regardless of the precise terminology.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attic and loft conversions are largely synonymous, both referring to transforming unused overhead space into a habitable room. Both involve structural changes and insulation.
